seo.title: Reservations
seo.description: Reservations at Izakaya WA in Houston are taken by phone only. Call the Memorial or River Oaks location to book a table. Questions and inquiries are welcome through the form on this page.

hero.title: Reserve your table by phone
hero.intro: We take reservations by phone only — there is no online booking. Call the location you'd like to visit and we'll take care of the rest. Walk-ins are always welcome.

phoneOnly.title: To book a table, please call us
phoneOnly.text: We don't take reservations online, by email, or through the form on this page. Call either location during opening hours and we'll find you a table. If you'd simply like to ask a question, use the form below and we'll get back to you.

intro.title: One call, and the table is yours
intro.paragraph: Reservations are handled by phone at each location — no online booking. Call us and we'll take care of the rest. For questions about the menu, a large party, or a special occasion, send us a message and we'll reply as soon as we can.

form.title: Questions & inquiries
form.intro: This form is for questions and general inquiries — not for reservations. To book a table, please call us. We'll reply to messages as soon as we can.

faqs.question: How do I make a reservation?
faqs.answer: By phone only. Call the Memorial or River Oaks location during opening hours and we'll book your table. We don't take reservations online, by email, or through the form on this page.

faqs.question: Can I reserve using the form below?
faqs.answer: No — the form is for questions and general inquiries only. To book a table, please call us. It's the fastest way and we can confirm your table right away.

faqs.question: Do you take walk-ins?
faqs.answer: Always. We keep seats for walk-in guests, though weekends and holidays fill up quickly — a call ahead is the surest way to get the table you want.

faqs.question: Can you host a large party?
faqs.answer: For parties larger than 12, or for a private event, please call us directly so we can plan the menu and the room with you.

faqs.question: Is there outdoor seating?
faqs.answer: Yes, both rooms offer outdoor seating and we're happy for groups. It's first-come, first-served unless arranged in advance.

closing.text: Planning something larger — a birthday, a tasting, a company dinner? Call us and we'll build a menu for the table.
